description: This file defines the 'GenericEntity' class, a core part of the OFBiz framework's entity engine. It functions as a dynamic, flexible value object that represents database entities. The class provides methods for managing entity fields, interacting with the database layer, generating XML representations, and handling various data types, including primary keys, serialization, and localization. It also supports observers for change notification, mutability controls, and custom hashCode and equals implementations.

classes.name: GenericEntity
classes.description: A dynamic, flexible entity value object capable of representing any database entity defined in the OFBiz framework. Implements Map for field access and includes mechanisms for change notification, mutability, serialization, XML generation, and various data conversions.

classes.name: GenericEntity.NullGenericEntity
classes.description: A singleton class representing a null or placeholder entity, immutable and returning '[null-entity]' as its entity name.

classes.name: GenericEntity.NullField
classes.description: A singleton class representing a null or placeholder field, with defined hashCode, equals, and compareTo methods, returning '[null-field]' as its string representation.

methods.name: createGenericEntity
methods.description: Factory method to create a new GenericEntity instance from a ModelEntity, delegator, and optional field map.

methods.name: refreshFromValue
methods.description: Refreshes the current entity's values from another GenericEntity instance, provided primary keys match.

methods.name: synchronizedWithDatasource
methods.description: Marks the entity as synchronized with the data source, saving original DB values and clearing change flags.

methods.name: removedFromDatasource
methods.description: Marks the entity as removed from the data source and immutable.

methods.name: setImmutable
methods.description: Sets the entity's mutability to false, making it immutable.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity.

methods.name: getModelEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the ModelEntity object that defines this entity.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the delegator instance responsible for this entity, retrieving it if necessary.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Associates a delegator instance with this entity.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified field.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified field, overwriting existing value.

methods.name: dangerousSetNoCheckButFast
methods.description: Sets a field value directly without validation, for internal use.

methods.name: dangerousGetNoCheckButFast
methods.description: Retrieves a field value directly without validation, for internal use.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Sets a field value from a String, converting it to the appropriate type.

methods.name: setBytes
methods.description: Sets a byte array field.

methods.name: setNextSeqId
methods.description: Retrieves the next sequence ID for an entity with a single primary key and sets it.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from a field, interpreting various string representations.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns a TimeDuration object representing the value stored in the field.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a field's value.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves a timestamp field.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Retrieves a time field.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves a date field.

methods.name: getInteger
methods.description: Retrieves an integer field.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Retrieves a long field.

methods.name: getFloat
methods.description: Retrieves a float field.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double field.

methods.name: getBigDecimal
methods.description: Retrieves a BigDecimal field.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Retrieves a byte array from a byte or blob field.

methods.name: makeXmlDocument
methods.description: Creates an XML Document from a collection of entities.

methods.name: addToXmlDocument
methods.description: Appends a collection of entities to an XML Document.

methods.name: makeXmlElement
methods.description: Generates an XML Element representing this entity.

methods.name: writeXmlText
methods.description: Writes the entity's XML representation as text to a writer.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on entity name and fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on entity name and fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a secure string representation of the entity, masking encrypted fields.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this entity to another based on primary key and other fields.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow clone of this entity.
